qa_items.title: Q298（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: Can hBP03-105 〈Lunaito〉 revealed by hBP03-001 〈Himemori Luna〉's SP Oshi Skill 'Lunaito Assemble' be attached to anyone other than 〈Himemori Luna〉?
qa_items.answer: No, it cannot.

qa_items.title: Q297（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If there are 4 copies of hBP03-105 〈Lunaito〉 in my Archive, can I use hBP03-001 〈Himemori Luna〉's SP Oshi Skill 'Lunaito Assemble'?
qa_items.answer: Yes, you pay the Holo Power, look through your deck, and since there are no hBP03-105 〈Lunaito〉 that can be attached to a Holomem, you resolve the effect and end it. [Updated 4/01] There was an error in the content posted on 3/11 (Tue). We apologize and have made the correction.

qa_items.title: Q296（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If there are no cards with 'PC' in my deck, can I use hBP03-001 〈Himemori Luna〉's Oshi Skill 'I Know PCs, No Problem!'?
qa_items.answer: Yes, in that case, you pay the Holo Power, look through your deck, and since there are no cards with 'PC' that can be added to your hand, you resolve the effect and end it.

qa_items.question: If there are no hBP03-107 〈35P〉 in my Archive, can I use hBP03-003 〈Sakura Miko〉's Oshi Skill 'Is 35P Coming Back!?'?

qa_items.question: If my Oshi Holomem is hBP03-004 〈FUWAMOCO〉, can I add hBP03-050 〈FUWAMOCO〉 to my hand using hBP03-084 〈Gorgeous PC〉?

qa_items.title: Q303（2025.03.11）

qa_items.title: Q302（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: Can hBP03-004 〈FUWAMOCO〉's Oshi Skill 'Moko-chan!' send Cheer to my own hBP03-050 〈FUWAMOCO〉?

qa_items.title: Q330（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: When I want to use hBP03-066 〈Inugami Korone〉's Gift 'Wonderful~♡' and hBP03-006 〈Inugami Korone〉's SP Oshi Skill 'WOW WOW WOW WOW,' which ability is processed first?
qa_items.answer: Since both abilities can be used 'when downed,' you can process them in any order you prefer.

qa_items.title: Q305（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: My hBP03-066 〈Inugami Korone〉 is stacked as the third card (on top of Debut and 1st Holomem) and gets downed during the opponent's turn. Afterward, I want to use hBP03-006 〈Inugami Korone〉's SP Oshi Skill 'WOW WOW WOW WOW' to return a Holomem to my hand. What does 'the stacked Holomem including the chosen Holomem' refer to in this case?
qa_items.answer: In this case, since hBP03-066 〈Inugami Korone〉 is stacked on top of Debut and 1st Holomem, you return one of the three cards of your choice to your hand.

qa_items.title: Q304（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If two of my 〈Inugami Korone〉 are downed simultaneously by the opponent's hBP01-087 〈Kobo Kanaeru〉's Arts 'Rain Mantra,' can I use hBP03-006 〈Inugami Korone〉's SP Oshi Skill 'WOW WOW WOW WOW' to reassign Cheer for both and return a Holomem to my hand for both?
qa_items.answer: No. Downing is processed one at a time, so the skill can only be used for one of them.

qa_items.title: Q308（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: Using hBP03-012 〈Himemori Luna〉's Bloom Effect 'Let's Make the Best Live Together,' I chose hBP01-096 〈Usada Pekora〉 with hBP01-123 〈Wild Rabbit Alliance〉 attached. Then, I performed a Collab and used the Collab Effect 'That's an Adventure,' and further rerolled the dice using hBP01-123 〈Wild Rabbit Alliance〉's ability. In this case, does hBP01-096 〈Usada Pekora〉's Arts get '+20' even if hBP01-123 〈Wild Rabbit Alliance〉 is no longer attached when the Arts is used?

qa_items.title: Q312（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: When the opponent's Performance Step begins, after using the Gift 'A Glimpse of a Foreign World' of hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉, if hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉 is downed by the Arts of the opponent's 〈Fubuki Shirakami〉, and due to the Favorite SP Skill 'Fubukingdom' of hBP02-001 〈Fubuki Shirakami〉, a die is rolled and an odd number comes up, does the effect of hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉's Gift 'A Glimpse of a Foreign World'—'Your Life won't be reduced by opponent's abilities'—not activate, resulting in Life being reduced by '-1'?
qa_items.answer: No, the Gift 'A Glimpse of a Foreign World' activates 'when the opponent's Performance Step begins,' so during that turn, even if hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉 is no longer on the field, your Life will not be reduced by '-1'.

qa_items.title: Q311（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: Does the effect of hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉's Gift 'A Glimpse of a Foreign World'—'Your Life won't be reduced by opponent's abilities'—prevent Life reduction even from Arts damage or Special damage that causes a Down?
qa_items.answer: No, Life reduction due to rules when downed by Arts damage or Special damage will still occur as normal Life damage. The effect only prevents reduction caused by abilities that directly state 'Life -X (value)'.

qa_items.title: Q370（2025.04.28）
qa_items.question: Using my hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉’s Arts 'Shining Comet', I downed the opponent’s Center Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. Then, after the down processing, I used my hBP01-007 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉’s SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' to down the opponent’s Back Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. In this case, when are the abilities of each hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 processed?
qa_items.answer: Processing priority is as follows: rule-based processes (like down processing) are handled first and fully resolved. Next, abilities that the turn player needs to process (such as abilities triggered upon use) are fully resolved with priority. Finally, abilities that the non-turn player needs to process (such as abilities triggered when damage is received) are fully resolved. Since hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 is an ability processed by the non-turn player, it is resolved last.

qa_items.question: If my Life is 1 and my hBP01-013 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached is downed by the opponent’s Arts damage, can I deal special damage to the opponent’s Holomem with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉’s ability?

qa_items.question: If I down an opponent’s 1st Holomem including Buzz using hBP01-013 〈Amane Kanata〉’s Bloom Effect 'Angel’s Work', does the opponent’s Life decrease due to the Extra ability 'When this Holomem is downed, your Life -2'?

qa_items.question: My Buzz Holomem received damage exceeding their remaining HP by more than 50 from the opponent’s hBP01-014 〈Amane Kanata〉’s Arts '♰Jet Black Wings♰'. In this case, how much Life Damage do I take?

qa_items.question: If I down the opponent’s Center Holomem with hBP01-014 〈Amane Kanata〉’s Collab Effect 'Fallen Angel' ability, can I deal damage to the opponent’s Life?

qa_items.title: Q211（2024.10.04）
qa_items.question: The opponent rolls the die with their Center Holomem hBP01-023 〈Tokino Sora〉's Arts 'Can't Stop Me!' and gets an odd number, allowing them to use this Arts one more time. If I have hBP01-027 〈Vestia Zeta〉 in my Collab Position, at which timing can I use the Gift 'V.7'?
qa_items.answer: You can choose to use it either when receiving damage from the first use of 'Can't Stop Me!' or the second use. ■If used when receiving damage from the first use: Roll the die with 'V.7' when taking damage from the first use and resolve the subsequent effects. qa_items.title: Q370（2025.04.28）
qa_items.question: I used hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉's Arts 'Shining Comet' to down a Center Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. After processing the down, I used my hBP01-007 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉's SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' to down the opponent's Back Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. In this case, when are the effects of each hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 processed?
qa_items.answer: Processing priority is as follows: Rule-based processes (such as down processing) are resolved first in full. Next, effects that need to be resolved by the turn player (such as effects that activate when used) are resolved in full. Finally, effects that need to be resolved by the non-turn player (such as effects that activate when damage is received) are resolved in full. Since hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 is an effect to be resolved by the non-turn player, it is processed last.

qa_items.title: Q216（2024.10.23）
qa_items.question: Using hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉's Arts 'Shining Comet', I reduced the HP of the opponent's Center Holomem, whose Oshi Holomem is hBP01-004 〈Usada Pekora〉, to 0. If both players want to use their respective SP Oshi Skills 'Shooting Star' and 'Wild Rabbits~', which is processed first?
qa_items.answer: When a Holomem's HP reaches 0, down processing is performed first. After the down is confirmed, the Oshi Skill 'Wild Rabbits~' is used. After resolving the effect and sending Cheer from Life to a Holomem, the SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' can be used.

qa_items.title: Q64（2024.09.21）
qa_items.question: If my hBP01-034 〈Aki Rosenthal〉 with 10 remaining HP has hBP01-114 〈Stone Axe〉 and hBP01-119 〈Jobs〉 attached and uses an Arts, can I deal Arts damage to the opponent's Holomem?
qa_items.answer: Yes, you can deal Arts damage. After declaring the use of the Arts, the effects of hBP01-114 〈Stone Axe〉 and hBP01-119 〈Jobs〉 that trigger 'When an Arts is used' are simultaneously activated and put into a pending state. After processing the Arts damage, you can choose the resolution order of the pending effects at the check timing. qa_items.title: Q62（2024.09.21）
qa_items.question: If my hBP01-034 〈Aki Rosenthal〉 with 10 remaining HP and hBP01-114 〈Stone Axe〉 attached uses an Arts, takes damage from the effect of hBP01-114 〈Stone Axe〉, and is downed, will my Center Holomem remain absent until the Reset Step of my next turn since there is no Center Holomem?

If there are only resting Holomems, move one of them to the Center Position while still in a resting state.

qa_items.title: Q370（2025.04.28）
qa_items.question: I used the Arts 'Shining Comet' of my hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 and downed the opponent's Center Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. After processing the down, I used the SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' of my hBP01-007 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 to down the opponent's Back Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. When are the effects of each hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 processed?
qa_items.answer: Processing priority is as follows: rule-based processes (such as down processing) are resolved first. Next, effects that need to be processed on the turn player's side (such as effects triggered upon use) are resolved in full. Finally, effects that need to be processed on the non-turn player's side (such as effects triggered when damage is taken) are resolved in full. Since hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 is an effect to be processed on the non-turn player's side, it is resolved last.

qa_items.title: Q286（2025.01.17）
qa_items.question: After dealing damage to the opponent's 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached, my Center Holomem was downed, I had no Back Holomem, and ended the turn with only Collab Holomems. Do I start the turn without a Center Holomem?

qa_items.title: Q230（2024.10.23）

qa_items.answer: Yes, you can deal damage. When hBP01-014 〈Amane Kanata〉 takes damage, the effect of hBP01-116 〈Upao〉, 'When the Holomem this Mascot is attached to takes damage,' is triggered and put into a pending state. After that, the rule-based down processing moves hBP01-014 〈Amane Kanata〉 and hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 to the Archive, and at the check timing, the pending effect 'When the Holomem this Mascot is attached to takes damage' is resolved.

820.cardType: サポート・イベント・LIMITED
820.abilityText:
You can only use this card when your Life is lower than your opponent’s.

If the opponent has no Collab Holomem, they must move one of their Back Holomem to the Collab position (this movement is not treated as a Collab).

LIMITED: You can only use 1 of this card per turn.

qa_items.title: Q369（2025.04.28）
qa_items.question: When the turn player uses hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉, which player chooses the Back Holomem to move to the Collab Position?
qa_items.answer: The player who did not use hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉 chooses.

qa_items.title: Q350（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If I use hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉 to move an opponent’s Back Holomem to the Collab Position, does the opponent move that Holomem back to the Back Position during their Reset Step?
qa_items.answer: Yes, they move it back to the Back Position and put it to rest.

qa_items.title: Q349（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If I use hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉 to move an opponent’s Back Holomem to the Collab Position, does the 'When Collaborated' ability activate?
qa_items.answer: No, it does not.

qa_items.title: Q348（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If the opponent has no Holomem in the Back Position and the Collab Position is empty, can I use hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉?
qa_items.answer: No, you cannot use it. If resolving the card results in no change to the game state other than placing the Support card in the Archive, the Support card cannot be played.

qa_items.title: Q347（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: When using hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉, can I move an opponent’s resting Holomem to the Collab Position?
qa_items.answer: Yes, you can.

qa_items.answer: No, Holo Power can only be gained when 'Collaborating.'

qa_items.answer: No, it cannot be used.

qa_items.question: The opponent rolled a die with the Arts 'Ain't Stoppin'!' of their Center Holomem hBP01-023 〈Tokino Sora〉, and since an odd number came up, they can use this Arts one more time. If I have hBP01-027 〈Vestia Zeta〉 in my Collab Position, at what timing can I use the Gift 'V.7'?

qa_items.title: Q370（2025.04.28）
qa_items.question: I used the Arts 'Shining Comet' of my hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 to knock down the opponent’s Center Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. After processing the knock-down, I used the SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' of my hBP01-007 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 to knock down the opponent’s Back Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. In this case, when are the abilities of each hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 processed?
qa_items.answer: Processing priority is as follows: rule-based effects (such as knock-down processing) are resolved first in full. Next, abilities that need to be resolved on the turn player’s side (such as effects triggered upon use) are resolved in full. Finally, abilities that need to be resolved on the non-turn player’s side (such as effects triggered upon receiving damage) are resolved in full. Since hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 falls under abilities to be resolved on the non-turn player’s side, they are processed last.

qa_items.title: Q216（2024.10.23）
qa_items.question: Using the Arts 'Shining Comet' of hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉, I reduced the HP of the opponent’s Center Holomem to 0, whose Oshi Holomem is hBP01-004 〈Usada Pekora〉. If both players want to use their respective Oshi Skills 'Wild Rabbits~' and my SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star,' which one is processed first?
qa_items.answer: When a Holomem’s HP reaches 0, knock-down processing is performed first, and after the knock-down is confirmed, the Oshi Skill 'Wild Rabbits~' is used. After resolving the ability and sending Cheer from Life to the Holomem, the SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' can be used.
